applicabilityBasis.summary: USDT is a fiat-referenced dollar token designed for payments and settlement, with issuer redemption for eligible verified customers at fixed fiat value less applicable fees.

genius.notes: Review dated 2026-10-07. Tether's January 27, 2026 USAT launch release says USDt is progressing towards GENIUS Act compliance; USAT has the distinct issuer Anchorage Digital Bank, N.A. The current February 26 token terms preserve Tether International, S.A. de C.V., El Salvador, CNAD authorization, eligible-customer fixed-fiat redemption net fees and restrictions on most U.S. Persons. Existing foreign home-country licensing and FinCEN registration do not establish GENIUS qualification. The public OCC/Treasury and issuer sources reviewed did not establish a USDT GENIUS approval, foreign-issuer registration or Treasury comparability determination; issuerPathway and foreignExceptionStatus remain unknown. The Act remains pre-effective, with expected January 18, 2027 effectiveness and July 18, 2028 general DASP deadline. Public reserve disclosure is present; the current FAQ specifies quarterly reporting and the June 30 BDO report is a point-in-time ISAE 3000 assurance report, not a monthly attestation or blanket GENIUS compliance opinion. warning-or-notice records the historical CFTC October 2021 order and NYAG February 2021 settlement, which predate GENIUS and must not be described as GENIUS enforcement or revocation.

negativeEvidenceReview.summary: Within these sources checked on 2026-10-07, no USDT/Tether International GENIUS PPSI approval, official application, OCC foreign-issuer registration or Treasury determination supporting the foreign exception was located. This finite public review does not establish that no confidential filing exists. CNAD home-country authorization, FinCEN registration and separate ADB-issued USAT do not qualify this issuer under GENIUS. Historical 2021 enforcement is separately identified.
